name: All Sea Charters
reason: A charter operator (boat trips), not a place: a spot is a place, not the way you get there.

name: Busselton Jetty
reason: Obvious headline draw with three counted sources (Wikivoyage Busselton, Tourism WA attractions, australiassouthwest.com): nearly 2 km heritage jetty with a train and the underwater observatory at its end.

name: Chariot Charters
reason: A charter/tour operator, not a place.

name: Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park
reason: National park with Wikivoyage, DBCA Explore Parks and board pages: caves, lighthouses, coastal walks and the Cape to Cape Track.

name: Ngilgi Cave
reason: Show cave named by Wikivoyage (Yallingup and Leeuwin-Naturaliste NP) and the australiassouthwest.com listing; semi-guided tours daily. (Nglili Cave in the marginal band is the same cave.)
